concrete-calculator.formula:
volume (cu ft) = length x width x (thickness in inches / 12)
cubic yards = volume (cu ft) / 27
with waste = cubic yards x (1 + waste%)
bags = ceil(volume with waste (cu ft) / bag yield)
bag yields: 80 lb = 0.6 cu ft, 60 lb = 0.45 cu ft, 40 lb = 0.3 cu ft

concrete-calculator.workedExample:
A 10 x 10 ft patio slab, 4 inches thick, 10% waste:

1. Volume = 10 x 10 x (4 / 12) = 33.33 cubic feet.
2. Cubic yards = 33.33 / 27 = 1.23 cy; with 10% waste = 1.36 cy.
3. 80 lb bags = ceil(36.67 / 0.6) = 62 bags.
4. 60 lb bags = ceil(36.67 / 0.45) = 82 bags.
5. 40 lb bags = ceil(36.67 / 0.3) = 123 bags.
